question: Sumit Antil received the Padma Shri 2022 award in which field?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sports**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sumit Antil** received the **Padma Shri 2022** award in the field of **Sports**.
 
• He is an Indian **Paralympic javelin thrower** who has made significant contributions to the field of athletics.
 
• Sumit Antil won a gold medal in the men's javelin throw F64 category at the **Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games**, setting a new world record.
 
• His achievements have brought immense pride to the nation and have been recognized with one of India's highest civilian honors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Shri** is the **fourth highest civilian award** in India, after the **Bharat Ratna, the Padma Vibhushan, and the Padma Bhushan**.
 
• It is awarded to Indian citizens in recognition of their distinguished contribution in various spheres of activity including the arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• The awards are announced every year on Republic Day (26th January).
 
• Recipients of the Padma Shri award are recommended by the Padma Awards Committee, which is constituted by the Prime Minister of India.
